services.name: Homes of the Rich & Famous Garden District Tour
services.desc: 2 Hours About Explore the lavish Garden District of New Orleans, home to the rich & famous. This elegant neighborhood was built in the 1800s to rival the beauty and splendor of the French Quarter. It has been used for decades as the backdrop for many popular television shows and major motion pictures. Many consider it the "Hollywood of the South." You might even see some actual filming going on in the neighborhood. See the homes of celebrities and local icons including the former homes of Anne Rice and Nicholas Cage. See the homes used in popular television series and movie sites 2 Hours • All Ages • Explore the lavish homes and gardens of New Orleans' most scenic neighborhood

services.name: Dead of Night Ghosts & Cemetery Bus Tour
services.desc: 2 Hours About Climb aboard our comfortable, air conditioned bus and escape into the darkness with your licensed guide as we take a ride to some of the most haunted locations outside of the French Quarter. You will cross one of the most notorious streets in the French Quarter once referred to as the port of missing men. Hear stories of murder, betrayal, and some of our scariest urban legends. Are they real? You decide! Visit the location of one of the city's most haunted grounds including several cemeteries. services.name: Vampire Tour
services.desc: 1.5 Hours About Enter the world of the undead as our licensed guides take you for an unforgettable journey into the darkest ends of the French Quarter. Experience the legends of famous New Orleans vampires, real and fictional. Visit locations associated with these creatures of the night including a visit to a once Vampire Tavern! Are there vampires still lurking in the French Quarter? You decide! The tour departs from the gates of Jackson Square on Chartres Street between St. Ann & St. Peter Streets directly in front of St. Louis Cathedral. services.name: New Orleans True Crime Tour
services.desc: The original walking tour company in New Orleans brings to life the New Orleans True Crime Tour. Many of these stories are not featured on our other tours. We have gone to great lengths to research the most notorious crimes including unsolved deaths, shocking "they almost got away with it" crimes, missing persons and kidnappings, and heinous murders. All stories are historically correct. Some have even made their way onto popular crime reality shows. Others have been covered up so well through the years, they are just now being revealed. Tours operate nightly at 5:15 PM & 7:45 PM and are 2 Hours - Visit the sites of New Orleans' most notorious crimes!
